page.overview:
What is Gravity Games?

Gravity Games is a subtheme of the Sports theme released in 2003.

LEGO Gravity Games were mainly intended to be based upon the real Gravity Games of winter of 2003.

These sets are known for their many features, including the ability to ramp and slide minifigures on snowboards or skateboards. Other sets create large parks that can be customized and recreated. These sets also come with obstacles and "stunt sticks" that can be used for special tricks.

Note: Half of this theme's line were Promotional sets:
